vxr-1.description: Modern front-protection apron for applications with exclusively frontal radiation exposure. Elastic sewn into the back panels ensures an optimal fit during long periods of wear. Optionally with protective back panels.

vxr-2.description: Front-protection apron that simply closes and reopens at the front. Ideal for exclusively frontal exposure – high wearing comfort and an excellent fit. Optionally with back protection.

pxr-sc.description: A reinterpretation of the classic tabard apron with an improved fit in the underarm area. Available in several configurations with a single or double shoulder clip. Back buckles as standard, optionally a height-adjustable elastic belt.

pxr-th.description: Tabard apron with various fastening options and an improved underarm fit. Versatile for different wearers, with robust all-round protection thanks to the overlap.

wxr.description: Wrap-around apron with double-layer protection in the overlap area. Variable overlap for different body shapes, several armholes. The elastic belt shifts the weight off the shoulders for greater comfort during long periods of wear.

wxr-f.description: Full-body wrap-around apron with overlapping front zones that achieve the stated protection level when correctly overlapped. Reduces core material and weight while providing all-round coverage of around 60% of the body circumference.

txr-w.description: Two-piece protective set of top and skirt that distributes the weight evenly across the shoulders and hips. Around 30 cm of overlap zone for flexible size adjustment and double protection over vital areas. Optionally different protection levels front and back.
specs: KXR-W standard wrap skirt / KXR-F full wrap skirt

txr-w-lite.description: Lighter variant of the TXR-W: reduced front overlap saves up to 15% in weight. Particularly suitable as a personal lead apron with an optimal fit. Optionally different protection levels front and back.
specs: KXR-W standard wrap skirt / KXR-F full wrap skirt

txr-b.description: Two-piece set with an elastic back for a particularly supportive, close-fitting hold – one of the most comfortable models in the range. Improved underarm fit with hundreds of combinations for women and men.
specs: Two-piece – top with elastic back + skirt

txr-f.description: Two-piece set with full overlap – when worn correctly it meets the full stated protection level to IEC 61331-3:2014. Improved underarm fit and individual fit for women and men.
specs: KXR-F full wrap skirt (half thickness in the front panels)

tpv.description: Thyroid collar for supplementary protection of the neck region, with a tapered front shape (V-shape). Lightweight, conforming and available in numerous colours and patterns.

tpd.description: Thyroid collar with a teardrop-shaped, downward-extended front covering for additional coverage. Lightweight and conforming, available in many colours.

tpdm.description: Magnetic D-Type thyroid collar with a teardrop-shaped front covering. Fastening is via high-quality neodymium magnets instead of hook-and-loop – this is more hygienic, does not catch hair and is therefore particularly suitable for longer hair.

tpb.description: Thyroid collar with a wide, rounded front covering for particularly generous coverage of the neck and upper chest region.

scatter-cap.description: Lightweight head cap to protect against scattered radiation in the head/skull area. Comfortable, adjustable and designed for everyday use.

sleeve.description: Sleeve to protect the shoulder and upper-arm area against scattered radiation – ideal as a complement to the apron for lateral exposure.

mini-sleeve.description: Short sleeve variant for targeted shoulder protection at minimal weight.

cricket-pads.description: Leg and optional foot protection against scattered radiation – protects the lower legs and feet during near-floor exposure, e.g. in interventional radiology.

mammo-shield.description: Specially developed underarm/chest protection that sits under the arm and follows the arm's movement – for additional protection of the sensitive underarm region during surgical procedures. Integrates into most lead aprons and tops.
specs: additional underarm protection during surgical procedures

ha172.description: Mobile stand for hanging storage of radiation-protection aprons. Sturdy frame with castors for flexible positioning in the room.

psmar.description: Floor stand with integrated swing arms for clearly organised storage of multiple aprons. Mobile and space-saving.

ha10kt.description: Mobile swing-arm stand for space-saving hanging of multiple aprons on swivelling arms.

ps10kt.description: Mobile stand with swivelling arms for the orderly storage of protective clothing.

m10s.description: Floor stand with a rotating swing-arm system: aprons can be hung all around to save space and are easy to remove.

ha5k.description: Wall-mounted swing arm for hanging multiple aprons; swivels for easy access. Also suitable as a wall/door holder (including SKHK, HARODPS10).

hangers.description: Matching hangers for the gentle, hanging storage of radiation-protection aprons – in various versions (wood, plastic-coated, wire).
